findings.reason: the done-when pins the outcome by requiring the expected set unchanged and the other inventory tests to keep passing, so a node implementing the narrow clauses lands correctly without a plan edit.
findings.text: §20's deliverable exempts any "function whose only rename source is a path it never wrote", but `_release_worktree_whole` (reckon/crew/routing.py:1184, `os.rename(tree, trash)` at :1218, the only rename in its body) renames a path it never wrote and must still be reported per the same deliverable's "It still reports every staged write it reports today" and per the inventory's unchanged expected set; only the two narrowing clauses ("a claim path created exclusively by a helper, or one it renames aside after that helper reported the file already present") exclude it, so the general sentence and the required-unchanged behaviour disagree
